Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DGFT Young Professional (YP) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DGFT Young Professional (YP) recruitment is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Young Professional (YP) post announced by the Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Economics, LLM/LLB with a PG Diploma in law, MBA from a top-ranked institution, or a B.Tech/B.E./MCA/Masters in Data Science/Analytics/Computational Mathematics.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional (YP) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Young Professional (YP) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 56,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the DGFT Young Professional (YP) recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DGFT Young Professional (YP) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional (YP) posts primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The Young Professional (YP) position is a contractual role. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis as per the terms and conditions of the DGFT.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the DGFT's official website. Links are provided in the Important Links section of this article.
